description: Address 3 issues found during v2 semantic code review (2026-08-13-073400-review.md). Wire up initWallConfigStoreSync as a self-initializing subscription, apply sum-correction rounding to row heights, and add finalization guard to setWallConfigAndFrames and populateZonesFromFrames.
steps: 1. Wire up initWallConfigStoreSync - call it at module level in wallConfigStore.ts as a self-initializing subscription so the stores stay synchronized without needing external wiring.
2. Apply applyRoundingWithSumCorrection to row heights in wallConfigEngine.ts instead of plain Math.round.
3. Add finalization guard (if (get().currentProject?.status === 'FINALIZED') return;) to setWallConfigAndFrames and populateZonesFromFrames in projectStore.ts.
acceptance_criteria: initWallConfigStoreSync is called and active (not dead code)
Row heights use the same sum-correction strategy as column widths
setWallConfigAndFrames and populateZonesFromFrames early-return when project is FINALIZED
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest run
